Commentary.Commentary: That is it from this game then! Another semi finals awaits and that is a clash between England and Australia. That game begins at 1715 IST (1145 GMT). Till then, take care and goodbye!
Parshavi Chopra is the PLAYER OF THE MATCH!

A very convincing win for India! They have outplayed New Zealand in all departments. First, after electing to bowl, they restricted them to a low score. All their bowlers were very impressive and later on, they knocked it off quite easily with the bat. Their openers got them off to a really good start, Shafali Verma fell but Shweta Sehrawat was brilliant. She played throughout and ended with a fifty-plus score. Excellent batting by her to round off what was quite a one-sided seme finals.
